recommended_areas.name: Jing'an

recommended_areas.name: Xuhui / Former French Concession

transport: Use metro as the backbone and avoid stacking too many cross-river transfers in one day.
Treat Puxi and Pudong as separate clusters unless the route has one clear crossing moment.
Keep shopping and dining in the same district whenever possible.
bad_weather_fallbacks: Shift waterfront walks to museums, malls, art centers, or food halls.
Use major commercial complexes and museums as rain-safe anchors.

leisure.pace_note: Shanghai works best when you balance one major icon with one neighborhood walking stretch.

family.pace_note: Use one large family attraction per day and pair it with a low-effort indoor backup.

food.pace_note: Keep meals neighborhood-based and leave time for queues and coffee breaks.

theme.pace_note: Choose one strong theme such as art, modern architecture, or concession-era urban history.

suggestions: Good weather for Bund walks and low-rise historic neighborhoods.
Use museums, malls, and design spaces as the main anchors.
